es.summary: El fondaparinux es un anticoagulante sintético que inhibe selectivamente el factor Xa, usado para profilaxis y tratamiento de trombosis venosa profunda y embolia pulmonar.
key_points: Profilaxis de DVT después de cirugía ortopédica o abdominal.
Tratamiento de DVT y EP en combinación con warfarina.
Contraindicado en sangrado activo y depuración de creatinina <30 mL/min.
No posee antídoto específico; monitorizar signos de sangrado.
Riesgo aumentado de hematoma epidural con anestesia neuraxial.

mechanism: Se une al antitrombina y bloquea de forma selectiva el factor Xa.
Impide la conversión de protrombina a trombina.
Reduce la generación de fibrina y la formación de coágulos.
indications: Profilaxis de trombosis venosa profunda en cirugía de cadera, rodilla o abdominal.
Tratamiento de DVT aguda y embolia pulmonar en combinación con warfarina.
contraindications: Sangrado mayor activo o riesgo alto de hemorragia.
Insuficiencia renal grave (depuración de creatinina <30 mL/min).
Historia de trombocitopenia inducida por heparina.
adverse_effects: Hematoma o equimosis en el sitio de inyección.
interactions: Aumenta el riesgo de sangrado con otros anticoagulantes o antitrombóticos.
Potencia el efecto de warfarina y puede elevar el INR.
Uso concomitante con AINES o antiagregantes plaquetarios incrementa hemorragias.
nursing_care: Evaluar hemograma, plaquetas y función renal antes de iniciar la terapia.
Monitorear signos vitales, hemoglobina/hematocrito y cualquier sangrado cada 12 h.
Observar el sitio de inyección para hematoma o eritema.
Retener la dosis y notificar al médico si ocurre sangrado activo o plaquetas <100 000 mm³.
Evitar inyecciones intramusculares y usar técnica subcutánea adecuada.
patient_teaching: Informar al paciente sobre signos de sangrado: hematuria, melena, hematomas extensos.
No usar AINES sin autorización y evitar procedimientos invasivos sin avisar al profesional.
Mantener el sitio de inyección limpio y observar cualquier enrojecimiento.
Reportar cualquier dolor lumbar o debilidad que pueda indicar hematoma espinal.

outcomes: Sin evidencia de sangrado activo en 72 h.
Hemoglobina estable dentro de ±1 g/dL del valor basal.

interventions.action: Monitorizar signos vitales y hemograma completo cada 12 h.
interventions.rationale: Detectar hemorragia temprana y cambios en la coagulación.

interventions.action: Evaluar el sitio de inyección para hematoma o eritema.
interventions.rationale: Identificar reacciones locales que puedan preceder a sangrado.

interventions.action: Verificar función renal (creatinina, depuración) antes de cada dosis.
interventions.rationale: Ajustar la dosis y prevenir acumulación del fármaco.

interventions.action: Retener la dosis y notificar al médico si ocurre sangrado activo o plaquetas <100 000 mm³.
Educar al paciente sobre evitar AINES y reportar cualquier sangrado.
interventions.rationale: Reducir riesgo de interacciones y facilitar detección precoz.

en.summary: Fondaparinux is a synthetic anticoagulant that selectively inhibits factor Xa, used for prophylaxis and treatment of deep vein thrombosis and pulmonary embolism.
key_points: DVT prophylaxis after orthopedic or abdominal surgery.
Treatment of DVT and PE in combination with warfarin.
Contraindicated in active bleeding and creatinine clearance <30 mL/min.
No specific antidote; monitor for bleeding signs.
Increased risk of epidural hematoma with neuraxial anesthesia.

mechanism: Binds antithrombin and selectively blocks factor Xa.
Prevents conversion of prothrombin to thrombin.
Reduces fibrin generation and clot formation.
indications: Prophylaxis of deep vein thrombosis in hip, knee, or abdominal surgery.
Acute DVT and pulmonary embolism treatment in combination with warfarin.
contraindications: Active major bleeding or high hemorrhage risk.
adverse_effects: Hematoma or ecchymosis at injection site.
interactions: Increases bleeding risk with other anticoagulants or antithrombotics.
Potentiates warfarin effect and may raise INR.
Concurrent use with NSAIDs or platelet aggregators increases bleeding.
nursing_care: Assess CBC, platelets, and renal function before starting therapy.
Monitor vital signs, hemoglobin/hematocrit, and any bleeding every 12 h.
Observe injection site for hematoma or erythema.
Hold dose and notify provider if active bleeding or platelets <100 000 mm³.
Avoid intramuscular injections; use proper subcutaneous technique.
patient_teaching: Inform patient of bleeding signs: hematuria, melena, extensive bruising.
Do not use NSAIDs without authorization and avoid invasive procedures without notifying provider.
Keep injection site clean and monitor for redness.
Report any lower back pain or weakness that may indicate spinal hematoma.

outcomes: No evidence of active bleeding within 72 h.
Hemoglobin stable within ±1 g/dL of baseline.

interventions.action: Monitor vital signs and complete blood count every 12 h.
interventions.rationale: Detect early hemorrhage and coagulation changes.

interventions.action: Assess injection site for hematoma or erythema.
interventions.rationale: Identify local reactions that may precede bleeding.

interventions.action: Check renal function (creatinine, clearance) before each dose.
interventions.rationale: Adjust dose and prevent drug accumulation.

interventions.action: Hold dose and notify provider if active bleeding or platelets <100 000 mm³.
Educate patient to avoid NSAIDs and report any bleeding.
interventions.rationale: Reduce interaction risk and facilitate early detection.

key_points.0.quote: Fondaparinux sodium injection is indicated for the prophylaxis of deep vein thrombosis (DVT), which may lead to pulmonary embolism (PE): in patients undergoing hip fracture surgery, including extended prophylaxis; in patients undergoing hip replacement surgery; in patients undergoing knee replacement surgery; in patients undergoing abdominal surgery who are at risk for thromboembolic complications.

key_points.1.quote: Treatment of DVT or acute pulmonary embolism (PE) when administered in conjunction with warfarin.

key_points.2.quote: Fondaparinux sodium injection is contraindicated in the following conditions: Severe renal impairment (creatinine clearance [CrCl] <30 mL/min).

key_points.4.quote: Spinal or epidural hematomas, which may result in long-term or permanent paralysis, can occur with the use of anticoagulants and neuraxial (spinal/epidural) anesthesia or spinal puncture.

sections.mechanism.0.quote: By selectively binding to ATIII, fondaparinux sodium potentiates (about 300 times) the innate neutralization of Factor Xa by ATIII.

sections.indications.0.quote: Fondaparinux sodium injection is a Factor Xa inhibitor (anticoagulant) indicated for: Prophylaxis of deep vein thrombosis (DVT) in patients undergoing hip fracture surgery (including extended prophylaxis), hip replacement surgery, knee replacement surgery, or abdominal surgery.

sections.indications.1.quote: Treatment of DVT or acute pulmonary embolism (PE) when administered in conjunction with warfarin.

sections.contraindications.1.quote: History of serious hypersensitivity reaction (e.g., angioedema, anaphylactoid/anaphylactic reactions) to fondaparinux sodium.
